name: Super Health Club
source:
[B]You’re the new branch manager of a local health club.[/b]
The previous manager made a huge mess of it and left the health club heavy in debt. It’s now up to you to make the health club profitable again. Make all the daily business decisions to achieve the most profit but remember to keep your staff members happy or you will see your goal slipping out of your fingers.

[From the [url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/shc-reg/] official website[/url]]
translation:
[B]你是当地一家健身俱乐部的新分店经理。[/b]
前任经理把事情搞得一团糟，让健身俱乐部负债累累。现在就靠你来让健身俱乐部再次盈利了。做出所有日常业务决策以实现最大利润，但请记住让你的员工感到高兴，否则你会发现你的目标从你的指缝中溜走。

[摘自[url=https://oonyxgames.com/game/shc-reg/]官网[/url]]
